pr_title: Add support for require-trusted-types-for and trusted-types
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/rails/rails/issues/42034

Just adds support for these two csp headers. 

Reference:
- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/trusted-types
- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/require-trusted-types-for
pr_comments: @lfalcao just one more thing - can you add an entry to CHANGELOG and squash your commits. Once that's done I'll merge it.
Thanks for adding support for this @lfalcao! :tada:

issue_context.title: ActionDispatch::ContentSecurityPolicy does not support for 'require trusted types for'
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce
Add a CSP policy for require trusted types for, i.e.:

```ruby
Rails.application.config.content_security_policy do |policy|
  policy.require_trusted_types_for("'script'")
end
```

This is an [experimental CSP policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/require-trusted-types-for).

### Expected behavior
It should add a CSP header policy like this `require-trusted-types-for: 'script'`.

### Actual behavior
An error was returned:

```ruby
`block in <main>': undefined method `require_trusted_types_for' for #<ActionDispatch::ContentSecurityPolicy:0x00007ffd25e7e030> (NoMethodError)
Did you mean?  require_sri_for
```

Probably because the policy isn't defined in [ActionDispatch::ContentSecurityPolicy::Request::DIRECTIVES](https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/85c6823b77b60f2a3a6a25d7a1013032e8c580ef/actionpack/lib/action_dispatch/http/content_security_policy.rb#L125), but it could also be something else.

### System configuration
**Rails version**: 6.1.3.1

review_comments:
Can you change this so you can pass multiple arguments and a symbol for `'allow-duplicates'` like you've done for `'script'`, e.g:

```
@policy.trusted_types "foo", "bar", :allow_duplicates
```

Thanks
